_about: Terms verdict for every site render-watch has a line for (research/channel-loop/TERMS-AUDIT-2026-09-29.md). A line may be active only when its site is NOT_BARRED or CONDITIONAL_MET, or TERMS_PENDING and the line is the site's terms page (slug starting 'terms-'). Since 30.9 (RULING-2026-09-30-video.md 16(d) D2(v)) NO_TERMS_ROBOTS_OK is active-eligible too, set only by scripts/robots-verdict.mjs (its source names the script and its note opens 'exhaustive-negative'; a hand-set one fails the gate), and a robots-only probe (slug starting 'robots-', URL path exactly /robots.txt) may be active only for a NO_TERMS site whose note opens 'exhaustive-negative' (D2(iv): a TERMS_PENDING site gets its terms page and nothing else). Since 4.10 (tick 40 review, defect 2) a line on a site in PATH_LIMITS (scripts/queue-zero-test.mjs termsGate) passes only under that site's listed paths: posthog.com under /docs/ and /tutorials/ (its repository licence asks that nothing outside /contents/ be copied). Enforced by src/__tests__/revenue/render-watch-terms-barred.test.ts.

posthog.com.source: research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md and research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-privacy-2026-10-04.md: pinned references (header, and the clauses relied on quoted as exact original line ranges with their sha256; the body is not copied, see each header's licence line) to PostHog/posthog.com src/pages/terms.tsx and src/pages/privacy.tsx at commit 35fc817dfc2b7ed21d59504e349d1f47616edb10 (both 'Last Updated: June 29, 2026', byte-identical at master HEAD 4c27ff7578f24c75b40d1024e4e0cbd40c9922ba), the pages served at posthog.com/terms and /privacy, fetched 2026-10-04 (github grade)
posthog.com.note: no clause bars or conditions automated access to posthog.com pages. The Terms 'apply to any Customer (as defined below) accessing or using PostHog cloud-based software, products or services ("PostHog Cloud")' (terms.tsx:328-330, research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:41-43) and bind 'By signing up to, creating an account, using or otherwise accessing PostHog Cloud' (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:52), 'on a free or pay-as-you-go basis' (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:58); the whole file was read and has no scraping, crawler, robot or automated-means clause. Its restrictions, 2.1, bind a Customer's use of the 'Licensed Materials', which are 'The Software and Other PostHog Materials' (terms.tsx:408-409, research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:103-104); 1.1 grants the Other PostHog Materials, 'the documentation, training materials or other materials, products or services supplied or provided by PostHog', for use '(a) internally' (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:79-80, research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:86-87), and 2.1(a) bars any use 'other than as specifically authorized in' 1.1 (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:120-121): so 2.1 reaches a Customer reading PostHog's documentation, not only its product. None of 2.1 bars reading by automated means; the nearest are 2.1(d), to 'access or use the Licensed Materials in a manner intended to circumvent or exceed any usage limits' (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:129-131), 2.1(e), to use them 'to interfere with, disrupt, or attempt to gain unauthorized access to any systems' (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:131-134), and 2.1(i), benchmarking (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:148-152). The Privacy Policy covers 'all visitors, users and customers of the PostHog.com hosted services and websites' (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-privacy-2026-10-04.md:42-44), binds 'By accessing or using any part of the Websites' (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-privacy-2026-10-04.md:53-55) and says PostHog 'automatically collects' each visitor's IP address and the content viewed (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-privacy-2026-10-04.md:74-77); it sets no access rule. The page-view reader's calls to eu.posthog.com are customer use of the query API, not a render line: they are held to 2.1 and to the API's documented limits (research/measurements/posthog-free-tier.md). Open caveat, for storage and not access: the repo's LICENSE asks 'Please do not duplicate, copy, or use our website' for everything outside /contents/ (PostHog/posthog.com LICENSE:5-6 at 35fc817), and the Terms' plain-English column says 'pleeeeeease don’t copy our website.' (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:203; that column is 'not legally binding', research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:24-25): no posthog.com page outside the docs is committed as a capture, and the terms gate admits a posthog.com line only under /docs/ or /tutorials/ (PATH_LIMITS in scripts/queue-zero-test.mjs), and the two files above quote instead of copying; the docs under /contents/ are MIT (LICENSE:12-32), but a Customer holds the same documentation under 1.1(a)(ii), for use 'internally', and may not 'otherwise make the Licensed Materials available to any third party other than Users' (2.1(b), research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:125-126), a User being an 'end user (person or machine) of Customer' (research/channel-loop/terms/posthog-terms-2026-10-04.md:108). The attached PostHog connector means an account exists, so the colony is taken to be a Customer (which organisation, and on which plan, is a live read not made here). Whether a committed docs capture rests on the MIT grant or falls under 1.1(a)(ii) and 2.1(b) is the main thread's call, to make before the first posthog.com line is queued.
